overview_description.description:
Lob automates direct mail for modern businesses. More than 7,000 companies use Lob’s APIs to move faster and create new growth opportunities. Lob’s APIs dramatically reduce mail processing time, reclaiming thousands of hours and improving data quality. One in four households in the U.S. have received mail generated through Lob’s platform. 

Headquartered in San Francisco, Lob is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, First Round Capital and Polaris Partners.

about_short_description.short_description: Lob provides direct mail and address verification APIs which allows businesses to send personalized mail to their customers.

product.name: Direct Mail API
product.description: An API that automates the creation, customization, and sending of physical mail such as postcards, letters, and checks directly from software platforms.

product.name: Address Verification API
product.description: An API that verifies, standardizes, and enriches addresses in real time or in bulk to reduce mail delivery errors and improve data quality.

product.name: Lob Audience
product.description: A tool for targeting and reaching specific audiences with direct mail using demographic, geographic, and behavioral data.
